measurement.reason: none of 244 records states a yearly change below -100%, and none of 1 curves that empty the pile takes out more than it holds

population.hero_definition: The yearly change = (in - out) x 12 / the pile, in %. It is the hero number. It never reads below -100%: a pile the curve empties within the year has lost all of itself, not more. A month takes out at most what the pile holds plus what comes in that month, and what comes in (emissions, or the typical token's inflow standing in for an unknown one) is at most what the reserve outside the pile still holds, so no curve buys back or burns more tokens than exist.
